full_sentence: Although the poem is short, it contains many deep meanings.
acceptable_variants: it still carries a powerful message.
it still reveals a complex emotion.

options.text: so the poet wrote it quickly.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, which does not provide the contrast that 'although' requires.

options.text: because it has only four lines.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' gives a reason and conflicts with 'although' in the same clause.

options.text: the poem was written in English.
options.why_wrong: This adds a fact but does not set up the contrast that 'although' requires.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. Turkish speakers sometimes add a result or reason connector after this structure, but English allows only one linking word per clause, so those options are wrong.
translation: Şiir kısa olmasına rağmen, birçok derin anlam içerir.
